description: A type parameter that grows with every method call, e.g. `Chainable<T & Record<K, V>>`, so the final type reflects the whole chain.
`{ [K in keyof T]: T[K] } & {}` flattens intersections into one readable object type.
`key: K extends keyof T ? never : K` rejects arguments based on the accumulated state while still inferring `K`.
Each step returns a new object, so runtime behavior matches the immutable type-level state.
